{{Top|leg}}
The '''Esplanade''' was a broad, [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-lined thoroughfare on [[Oseon 6845]]. The cobblestoned avenue was built for pedestrian traffic, and equipped with an [[Artificial gravity generator/Legends|artificial gravity field]] to accommodate a variety of [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was lined with an array of shops, catering to the very rich, and it was said that the commercial footage along the domed Esplanade was the most expensive in the [[Universe/Legends|known universe]].
